_comment: TEMPLATE — /iadc-graph:setup asset. Describes the "iadc" block this skill merges into the client repo's .mcp.json, under mcpServers.iadc — never as a standalone file. Every _comment key here is a note to the skill and is dropped from what actually gets written; the real file gets LITERAL values, not ${VAR} (the Windows Desktop app does not reliably expand ${VAR} in .mcp.json).

iadc._comment: The graph MCP is served by the standalone Graph service, over cleartext http, on a different port than any review API — the api-key here is the Graph service's own key, not any other service's. The scheme becomes https once the endpoint is TLS-terminated; until then http is correct and https fails the handshake.
